d: Short, straight ash-blonde hair with bangs and a side part frames a youthful, teenage face with sharp, narrow blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white military-style jacket with gold buttons and gold-trimmed cuffs, paired with a matching short white skirt, black knee-high socks, and white loafers with gold buckles. A pair of oversized aviation goggles with dark lenses rests atop the head, and two massive, long-bladed swords with gold accents are positioned diagonally behind the back.
